title: Understanding Speech AI: Turning Voice into Data and Back
introduction: Speech AI lets computers listen to, understand, and speak like humans. It powers many tools we use every day, from voice assistants to automatic captions.

sections.heading: What is Speech AI?
paragraphs: Speech AI refers to technologies that let computers listen to, understand, and generate human speech.
It bridges the gap between spoken language and digital information, enabling many everyday tools.

example.title: Voice Assistant Greeting
example.content: When you say “Hey Siri”, the device captures your voice, converts it to text, processes the request, and may reply with spoken words.

sections.heading: Speech Recognition (Speech-to-Text)
sections.subheading: How machines turn spoken words into written text
paragraphs: Speech recognition listens to audio and matches sounds to words using trained models.
The output is a text version of what was spoken, useful for transcription and commands.

example.title: Transcribing a Meeting
example.content: A recorder captures a meeting, and speech recognition software creates a written transcript automatically.

sections.heading: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
paragraphs: Text-to-speech converts written words into natural‑sounding audio.
It uses voice models to generate speech that can be heard on phones, GPS devices, and more.

example.title: Reading an Article Aloud
example.content: A news app uses TTS to read the article to you while you drive.

sections.heading: Basic Audio Understanding
paragraphs: Beyond words, audio AI can identify sounds like music, alarms, or animal noises.
It can also recognize who is speaking, their emotion, or language.

example.title: Smart Home Noise Alerts
example.content: A home system hears a baby cry and sends a notification to the parents' phone.

practice.title: Try a Simple Speech-to-Text Test
practice.instruction: Use a free online speech-to-text tool (e.g., Google Docs voice typing). Speak a short sentence like “I love learning about AI” and see the text appear. Note any errors and think why they happened.

keyTakeaways: Speech AI lets computers listen to and understand human voice.
Speech recognition converts spoken words into written text.
Text-to-speech turns written text into natural sounding speech.
Audio AI can detect sounds, identify speakers, and power many everyday devices.

mcqs.question: What is the main purpose of speech recognition in Speech AI?
options: To convert spoken audio into written text
To generate spoken audio from written text
To identify the language being spoken
To detect background noises
mcqs.explanation: Speech recognition, also called speech-to-text, listens to audio and matches sounds to words, producing a text version of what was spoken.

mcqs.question: In the voice‑assistant example, what happens after the device converts your spoken command to text?
options: The device powers off automatically
The system processes the request and decides how to respond
The text is printed on a piece of paper
The audio is recorded again for verification
mcqs.explanation: After converting speech to text, the assistant uses the text to understand the request and then processes it to generate an appropriate response.

mcqs.question: Which technology allows a news app to read an article aloud while you drive?
options: Speech recognition
Audio fingerprinting
Text-to-speech
Speaker identification
mcqs.explanation: Text-to-speech (TTS) converts written words into natural‑sounding audio, enabling apps to read text aloud.

mcqs.question: Basic audio understanding can identify which of the following?
options: The speaker's name
The current weather forecast
Background music or alarms
The user's exact location
mcqs.explanation: Beyond words, audio AI can detect sounds such as music, alarms, or animal noises, but it does not directly determine personal details like a name or location.

mcqs.question: Why might a free online speech‑to‑text tool sometimes produce incorrect transcriptions?
options: Because it also uses text‑to‑speech at the same time
Because background noise can interfere with sound recognition
Because it cannot store the audio file
Because it only works with handwritten text
mcqs.explanation: Background noise can confuse the speech recognition model, leading to errors in the generated text.
